<!--- Provide a general summary of your changes in the Title above -->

### WIP

#### Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
- Major refactor on ApiDataProvider to support new changes
- Add organization endpoints and associated objects
- Refactor Test.Api Namespace for better organization and reduction of redundant code
- Refactor FactorFileProviders/MapFileProviders/ChainProviders to use the DataProvider to fetch files (So we can use ApiDataProvider or other as well to fetch these files)
- Add ZipFile data providers for FactorFiles/MapFiles

#### Related Issue
<!--- This project only accepts pull requests related to open issues -->
<!--- If suggesting a new feature or change, please discuss it in an issue first -->
<!--- If fixing a bug, there should be an issue describing it with steps to reproduce -->
<!--- Please link to the issue here: -->
Closes #5021 
Closes #4663 

#### Motivation and Context
<!--- Why is this change required? What problem does it solve? -->
Currently there are issues using the ApiDataProvider where you cannot specify the TickType and it will download whatever is available, even if lean is making a request for tradebar it may download quote, even if we already have it locally. 

This PR aims to simplify the entire process by passing the FilePath key, which is standardized in Lean to contain all the required information about the data requested, to QC's Api. This way we can request any type of data directly from QC. This change also coincides with some major changes to the data/ endpoints for QC's Api. 

This PR also refactors some our providers (FactorFile/MapFile/OptionChain/FutureChain) to use the data provider instead of reading directly from disk themselves, allowing these types of files to be fetched at runtime by the ApiDataProvider or any IDataProvider for that matter. 

#### Requires Documentation Change
<!--- Please indicate if these changes will require updates to documentation, and if so, specify what changes are required -->
API documentation will have to updated to reflect the changes in lean and to the QC Api

issue_context.title: Add organizations/read API endpoint
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the behavior you expect to see for your case. -->

There is an organizations/read API endpoint which can be used to retrieve display-friendly organization names of the organizations a user is in.

This endpoint can be used in [QuantConnect/quantconnect-cli](https://github.com/QuantConnect/quantconnect-cli) which already has some neat interactive project and backtest selectors, but is lacking a "neat" interactive organization selector because there is no way to get a list of display-friendly names of the organizations a user is in.

With neat interactive project selector I mean this:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/14951909/91369041-f078ff80-e80a-11ea-87a4-6a78b4c86dc6.png)

Against this (which is the current "non-neat" organization selector):
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/14951909/91369163-5bc2d180-e80b-11ea-8552-cfa39ffaef56.png)

#### Actual Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the actual behavior for your case. -->

There is no way to map organization ids from the projects/read endpoint to a display-friendly organization name via the REST API.
